# Spica — Open Domain-Model Specification & Toolchain for Spec-Driven Development (SDD)

> Spica is an open domain-model specification and projection toolchain for Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Open ADM is the specification; Spica is the toolchain. It eliminates spec drift and AI coding hallucinations by defining business domain invariants once in a machine-verifiable format (Open ADM) and deterministically projecting into OpenAPI 3.0 contracts, C4 Level 1 context diagrams, topological domain aggregate maps, and interactive domain canvases.

- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/sim-way/spica
- **npm Package:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/@simway/spica
- **License:** Apache 2.0

---

## 🤖 1-Minute Quick Start for AI Agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex)

If you are an AI coding agent or terminal agent, install the official Spica Architect skill in one command:

```bash
# Add Spica Architect skill to Claude Code
npx skills add sim-way/spica --skill spica-architect

# Or add globally across Claude Code and Cursor
npx skills add sim-way/spica --skill spica-architect -g --agent claude-code cursor
```

Prompt your agent:
> "Design a [Domain] model using Spica Open ADM and save it as .spica/[domain].adm.json"

---

## 🛠️ CLI Usage (Zero Installation via npx)

Run Spica CLI directly against any `<domain>.adm.json` model:

```bash
# 1. Mathematically verify state machine transitions & domain invariants (exits 0 if valid)
npx -y @simway/spica validate .spica/domain.adm.json

# 2. Build and project all lenses atomically in one command
npx -y @simway/spica build .spica/domain.adm.json

# 3. Project production-grade OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract with typed schemas & errors
npx -y @simway/spica project-openapi .spica/domain.adm.json -o openapi.json

# 4. Project C4 System Context diagram (Mermaid C4Context format)
npx -y @simway/spica project-c4 .spica/domain.adm.json -o c4-context.mmd

# 5. Project Domain Aggregate Map (Mermaid format)
npx -y @simway/spica project-domain-map .spica/domain.adm.json -o domain-map.mmd

# 6. Project Domain Canvas (bi-directional Markdown)
npx -y @simway/spica project-ddd-canvas .spica/domain.adm.json -o domain-canvas.md
```

---

## 📋 Open ADM Core Schema Structure

An Open ADM model is a strongly-typed JSON document (`AstRoot`):

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
  "domainName": "OrderManagement",
  "description": "Order lifecycle and fulfillment domain",
  "aggregates": [
    {
      "name": "Order",
      "rootEntity": "Order",
      "description": "Customer order aggregate root",
      "stateMachine": {
        "initialState": "Created",
        "states": ["Created", "Paid", "Shipped", "Delivered", "Cancelled"],
        "transitions": [
          { "from": "Created", "to": "Paid", "trigger": "PayOrder" },
          { "from": "Paid", "to": "Shipped", "trigger": "ShipOrder" },
          { "from": "Shipped", "to": "Delivered", "trigger": "DeliverOrder" },
          { "from": "Created", "to": "Cancelled", "trigger": "CancelOrder" }
        ]
      },
      "commands": [
        {
          "name": "PayOrder",
          "params": [{ "name": "paymentMethod", "type": "string" }],
          "emitsEvents": ["OrderPaid"]
        }
      ],
      "events": [
        {
          "name": "OrderPaid",
          "fields": [{ "name": "paidAt", "type": "string" }]
        }
      ],
      "invariants": [
        "Order total must be strictly positive",
        "Paid orders cannot be cancelled without refund"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 🔄 Multi-Lens Projections Matrix

| Lens | Target Platform | Output Format | CLI Command |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **API Contract** | REST APIs / Gateways | Valid OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification with typed request/response schemas | `spica project-openapi` |
| **Macro Architecture** | Documentation & ARB | C4 Level 1 System Context (`C4Context`) diagram | `spica project-c4` |
| **Domain Map** | Architecture Reviews | Topological aggregate map & state machines | `spica project-domain-map` |
| **Domain Canvas** | Team Discovery & Visual Modeling | Tabular aggregate state matrix & Markdown import/export | `spica project-ddd-canvas` |

---

## 💻 Programmatic TypeScript SDK (`@simway/spica`)

```typescript
import { validateAdm, projectOpenApi3Spec, projectDomainAggregateMap } from "@simway/spica";

const result = validateAdm(myDomainModel);
if (!result.valid) {
  console.error("Invariant errors:", result.errors);
  process.exit(1);
}

// Project OpenAPI 3.0
const openapi = projectOpenApi3Spec(result.model);

// Project Mermaid Domain Map
const mermaid = projectDomainAggregateMap(result.model);
```
